# Torch

> Torch combines expert human coaching with Spark AI technology to drive leadership development and organizational transformation at enterprise scale.

Torch is a leadership development and coaching platform that integrates professional coaches, AI-powered guidance through Spark AI, and organizational intelligence analytics. The platform serves enterprise clients across industries, helping organizations navigate change, build leadership capacity, and achieve business outcomes through integrated coaching solutions.

## Key Topics

- Leadership Development
- Spark AI Agent
- Organizational Intelligence
- Change Coaching
- Executive Coaching

- Organizational Transformation

- Capacity Building
- Coaching Platform
- Business Outcomes
- Digital Transformation
- Organizational Change
